annotations.title: Read a study with its method

description: One Maps Agent research or statistics page: the findings with the method behind them (instrument, dataset, sample size, time window, population, exclusions, provenance), its key figures, sources and datasets as data. A statistics page gathers published studies: its method lives with each source, so method is null and sources carry the studies. Read body_markdown for the text and pass part to continue a long page. Set detail to text to place the body in the text block. Without a ref: the list of published studies.

detail.description: Where to put the markdown: structuredContent.body_markdown (default) or the text content block.

part.description: Which part to read, starting at 1. The first part gives the contents of a longer page.

ref.description: A research page URL, path or slug; omit to list the studies.

name: get_research

body_markdown.description: Markdown for this part of the page. Omitted when detail is text.

contents.description: Headings from a longer article, returned in the first part.

datasets.description: The datasets the study cites; url is the public data file on maps-agent.com, null when the dataset has none.

faqs.description: The page's FAQ, also at the end of body_markdown.

id.description: The page's id for fetch: its full URL.

key_figures.description: The study's key figures as published, or null.

method_text.description: The method as a markdown list.

results.description: Without a ref: the studies, newest first.
